full_judgment: 2. In Customs Appeal No. 17 of 2008, the appellant Md Shahadat Hossain, proprietor of M/s Shahadat Hossain, Seuzgari, Bogra, was proceeded against for alleged importation of excess wheat’s from India through Hilli Station, Dinajpur under Bill of Entry No. 4667 dated 11-6-2005 and Bill of Entry No. 48/72 dated 21-6-2005, EXP No. 2292 dated 10-6-2005 being covered under Letter of Credit No. 1945-05-01-0272 dated 9-6-2005. Accordingly, the appellant was found liable for punishment for violation of the provisions under sections 16 and 32 of the Customs Act, 1969 and section 3(1) of the Import and Export Control Act, 1950 and thereby found to have committed offence under sections 156(1), 9(1) and 14 of the Customs Act, 1969 and was imposed a penalty of Taka 10 lac by the Commissioner of Customs, Rajshahi vide Adjudication Order dated 5-4-2006 as communicated vide Nothi No. 5-CUS-8(92) Aniom/Hilli/05/2609(6) dated 24-4-2006. Being aggrieved by this Adjudication Order, the appellant-importer preferred an appeal before the Customs, Excise and Vat Appellate Tribunal, Dhaka (respondent No. 2) (hereinafter called "the Tribunal") under section 196A of the Customs Act, 1969 ("the said Act"). However, since the appellant did not, or failed to, deposit 50% of the penalty imposed in compliance with the provisions of section 194 of the said Act, his Appeal was rejected by the Tribunal as being not maintainable vide impugned order dated 20-2-2008 as communicated by Nothi No. CEVT/CASE(Cus)- 287/2006/152(1-2) dated 25-2-2008. As against this order, the Appellant has preferred the instant Appeal before the High Court Division under section 196D of the said Act.
